bugs.description: The wrapper function does not use functools.wraps, so the decorated function loses its __name__ and __doc__ metadata.

Non-retryable exceptions (those not in retryable_exceptions tuple) are not caught by the except clause, which is correct behavior. However, if retryable_exceptions is set to an empty tuple (), the function will never retry and any exception propagates immediately — this edge case may not match user expectations if they pass an empty tuple expecting 'retry nothing'.
